integration_rules: Use least-privilege credentials stored in GitHub Actions secrets or provider secret stores, never in Git or Notion.
Use reusable workflows or repository_dispatch only after the receiving repository and permissions are verified.
Use idempotent job identifiers and record run URLs and outcomes.
Do not auto-merge pull requests or modify repository permissions automatically.
Do not treat a listed repository as connected until its workflow and required access have been tested.
